# BYZ scope. The line runs: set up and not ended.

# BYZ scope. Calm enough for this line's events (design 3.3; the same as D4's oe_lat_calm): no civil war, no theme
# revolt, no Byzantine intrigue.
oe_un_calm = {
    in_civil_war = no
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active }
    oe_bi_active = no
}
# BYZ scope. The Ottomans exist and the house of Osman has not joined the empire.
oe_un_ott_ok = { country_exists = c:TUR NOT = { has_variable = oe_osman_chain_active } }
# BYZ scope. The historical premise (design 3.3): the Ottomans hold Adrianople or 3+ places of the Thracian theme region,
# the empire holds Constantinople, and the strong route has not voided the line.
oe_un_weak_ok = {
    oe_un_ott_ok = yes
    c:TUR = { OR = { location:edirne = { owner = c:TUR } any_owned_location = { count >= 3 var:oe_theme_region ?= 2 } } }
    location:constantinople = { owner ?= c:BYZ }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_strong }
}
# BYZ scope. The strong route (design 3.3): an ecumenical council of the restored empire (oe_ar.9), or Rome in our hands.
oe_un_strong_now = {
    OR = {
        has_country_modifier = oe_ar_council_orthodox
        has_country_modifier = oe_ar_council_union
        has_country_modifier = oe_ar_council_roman
        location:rome = { owner ?= c:BYZ }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Interface for other lines (design 4.2); they never write oe_un_st.
# Talks of union with Rome are under way (a promise to Rome not yet kept).
oe_un_talks = { has_variable = oe_un_talk }
# Union with Rome is in force: signed (Florence, or the Basel party's council) or proclaimed in the City.
oe_un_made = { OR = { var:oe_un_st ?= 2 var:oe_un_st ?= 3 } }
# A union once signed was declared void, or Rome's condition was refused.
oe_un_void = { var:oe_un_st ?= 4 }

# BYZ scope. Each event's own trigger (also checked when a delayed follow-up or a test button fires it).
oe_un_ev_10 = { religion = religion:orthodox country_exists = c:PAP }

# BYZ scope. The monthly check may roll this event (its trigger plus the window and the line's state).
oe_un_ok_10 = { oe_un_ev_10 = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_done_10 } current_date >= 1435.1.1 current_date <= 1445.12.31 var:oe_un_st ?= 0 oe_un_calm = yes oe_un_weak_ok = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_byd_stage } oe_bet_running = no OR = { current_date >= 1440.1.1 NOT = { is_situation_active = situation:western_schism } } }

# BYZ scope. The chronicle row (hook into gen_chronicle.py; precedence there: void > done > run > wait).
# Void: the strong route, or the window of .10 passed with no union and no talks.
oe_un_chr_void = {
    OR = {
        has_variable = oe_un_strong
        AND = { var:oe_un_done_10 ?= 2 var:oe_un_st ?= 0 NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_talk } }
    }
}
# Done: proclaimed, repudiated or converted, or the line has closed (1453, or the City lost for good).
oe_un_chr_done = {
    OR = { var:oe_un_st ?= 3 var:oe_un_st ?= 4 var:oe_un_st ?= 5 has_variable = oe_un_off }
}
# Running: talks under way, a union signed, or the invitations of .10 answered.
oe_un_chr_run = {
    OR = { has_variable = oe_un_talk var:oe_un_st ?= 2 var:oe_un_done_10 ?= 1 }
}
